answer: A payout is split and therefore 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The opal schedule is applied in quill and basalt publishes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3428 identities would post 892 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
